summary: Full regression on Unified AI Price Analysis (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations) + sanity pass on critical flows. Endpoint returns full schema {range_min,range_max,average,verdict,recommendation,comparables[],sample_size}. critical_code_review_comments: AIPriceAnalysis.jsx is clean 203 LOC, single component, dual-variant (inline/compact), well-tested testids. Good server-side sanitisation in server.py (safe_comps strips agent/owner/id/urls, caps title 120ch, recommendation 280ch, comparables to 5).
Backend fallback in server.py L988-1004 is deterministic and never surfaces a 500 when Claude fails — good defensive design.
canRun guard (L121) requires property_type AND (city||suburb) AND price>0 — properly hides button on zero-price/incomplete listings.
PropertyCard AI is absolute-positioned with e.preventDefault() on wrapper to stop click-through to link — nice UX.
